About SirenOpt
SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.
SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.
We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

 CSA Group’s Graduate Development Program will provide you with the opportunity to gain the needed technical and project management skills required to become a Product Safety Engineer in our Cleveland laboratory. The Product Safety Engineer role is critical to ensuring that our clients’ products comply with global and regional safety and performance standards; this allows our clients to sell their products around the world.
   

  

 If you have recently graduated or are anticipating to graduate within the 2026\-2027 academic calendar year, we want you to apply. The target start date for our Product Safety Engineer (Graduate Development Program) is June 2027\.
   

  

 To learn more about CSA Group, please visit: https://www.csagroup.org/about\-csa\-group/careers/
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Be curious and eager to learn new technologies while applying basic electrical theory.
* Be willing to think outside the box to apply efficient methods of doing different tasks related to testing and certification.
* Work closely with a variety of Certification Managers to successfully complete training.
* Manage certification projects with the assistance of a mentor ensuring compliance with all applicable safety requirements.
* Evaluate products against requirements of the national standards and guidelines.
* Job shadow Product Safety Engineers and Laboratory Technicians to meet training requirements.
* Review test data/reports and show an understanding of technical requirements to support the application of the CSA Mark.
* Compile subsequent certification reports.
* Keep the Managers informed of project status as required, pointing out progress and findings.
* Correctly interpret the results from the tests.


**Qualifications**
* New or recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving ability.
* Must be detail oriented.
* Strong organizational, time management, and project management skills.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to work unsupervised, in a team\-based work environment.
* Must be self\-motivated and client\-service oriented
